title: Fantastic and fascinating museum
text: The National Art Museum of Catalonia finds itself in an amazing building lying on a hill in the city of Barcelona, to wit the Palau Nacional de Montjuic. The building is a huge Italian classicist style palace whose construction was completed in 1929 under the architects Eugenio Cendoya and Enric Catà's design. In the very center of the building above the main entrance there is a large dome which reminds that of St. Peter's Basilica in the Vatican.
